---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement or new capability
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: davidleconte
---

## Problem

What are you trying to do that the project doesn't support today? Describe the
need, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. If it touches architecture or a contract boundary,
note that — significant changes are recorded as ADRs (see `GOVERNANCE.md`).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you set them aside.

## Additional context

Links, prior art, or examples. Note whether you'd be willing to contribute the
change via a pull request.
